Google Taiwan unification/independence polls. The vast majority of Taiwanese do not desire reunification. They support either independence or to maintain the "status quo" (i.e. independence). Meanwhile, the mirror opposite stance exists in China, as the CCP uses everything from public school geography classes to the daily weather report to reinforce the idea that Taiwan is an integral part of China. If you think an American gets fired up by an issue like abortion, just ask the next Chinese foreign student about their view on Taiwan, and you'll observe some real heat.

My layman's prediction is that, following some kind of economic catastrophe in the U.S. and/or China, the CCP will use force to reassert control over Taiwan, offering its economically-depressed masses a few years of bread and circus.
